title: Performance Overhaul
description: An optimisation mod for Minecraft so that the game can run significantly faster
body:
**Make your Minecraft experience significantly better with this single performance modpack!**
### Some Mods that are includeed are:
- Sodium
- Mouse Tweaks
- Lamb Dynamic Lights (LDL)
- Lithium
- Zoomify
- Gamma Utils

###  Some Resource Packs that are includeed are:
- Bare Bones
- Fast Better Grass
- Low On Fire
